spells.notes: Named and appointed on the morning of 1989-07-19 (매일경제 1989-07-19, 한국경제 1989-07-20). His successor was announced on Saturday 1990-03-17, and he held his 이임식 at 10:30 that morning (동아일보 1990-03-17), but the new ministers received their 임명장 only on the morning of Monday 1990-03-19 (한국일보 1990-03-20, 동아일보 1990-03-19). If the 경질 of 03-17 took legal effect that day, the end is 1990-03-17 and 03-18 is a vacancy. ko.wikipedia gives 1990-03-17 (the announcement day). issues.desc: Convention for the 1988-02-25 reappointment. 이상희 (内務, 李相熙) was one of the seven 5공 ministers kept in the first 노태우 cabinet (named 1988-02-19). The 5공 cabinet's blanket resignations were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 and the new cabinet received its 임명장 the same morning. This file splits him into a 전두환 spell ending 1988-02-25 (end_reason resigned) and a 노태우 spell starting 1988-02-25, as the MOIS page (48대, 49대), ko.wikipedia and justice.ext88.json (정해창) do. reorg_continuation stays false because this is not a reorganization. The assembler may want a flag that joins the pair.

Announcement day against 임명장 day. In eight reshuffles the appointment was announced on one day and the 임명장 given on a later day. They are 1990-03-17/19, 1991-04-27/29, 1992-03-30/31, 1993-12-21/22, 1994-12-23/24, 1995-12-20/21, 1997-03-05/06 and 1997-08-05/06. Starts follow the 임명장 day, which the MOIS page prints in every case. ko.wikipedia prints the announcement day for 1990-03-17, 1992-03-30, 1993-12-21, 1994-12-23, 1995-12-20 and 1997-03-05. nomination_date is the announcement day and outcome_date the 임명장 day. Ends of the replaced holders follow the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor) unless a dated 사표 수리 or 의원면직 was reported, as for 안응모 (1991-04-27), 김우석 (1997-02-13) and 이상희 (1988-05-07). This matches justice.ext88.json.

One-day vacancy on 1991-04-28. The President accepted 안응모's resignation on the evening of 1991-04-27 and named 이상연 the same evening (동아일보, 조선일보, 한겨레 1991-04-28, 서울신문 1991-04-28, 국민일보 1991-04-29, 대한민국사연표 tcct_1991_04_27_0010), but 이상연's 임명장 was given on the morning of 1991-04-29 (서울신문 1991-04-30, 중앙일보 1991-04-29). If the 면직 took effect only with the successor's appointment, 안응모's end is 1991-04-29 and there is no vacancy. If the appointment itself took effect on the announcement day, 이상연's start is 1991-04-27. The MOIS page gives 1991-04-28 and 1991-04-29 under its day-before convention, and ko.wikipedia 1991-04-27 and 1991-04-29. The sitting 차관 최인기 is recorded as an inferred acting head for 1991-04-28 (see acting).

1993-02-25 handover. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 (BigKinds 01100901.19930225151908002) says '현승종국무총리 등 이임정부의 각료들은 25일 일괄사표를 제출,전원 수리됐다', which would end 백광현 on 1993-02-25. 매일경제 1993-02-24 (News Library 1993022400099202004) quotes 총무처 that no blanket resignation was needed and that outgoing ministers would hand over when the new ministers were appointed, and several outgoing ministers held their 이임식 on 1993-02-26. The end here is 1993-02-26 (inferred_from_successor), as justice.ext88.json does for 이정우. With a 02-25 end there would still be no vacancy.

1990-03-17 and 1992-03-30. For 김태호 (announced 경질 and 이임식 on Saturday 1990-03-17, successor's 임명장 on 1990-03-19) and 이상연 (named 안기부장 and '임명·발령' per 한겨레 on 1992-03-30, 임명장 on 03-31), the end is the successor's 임명장 day. If the announcement day is the legal date, 김태호 ends on 1990-03-17 with a vacancy on 03-18, and 이상연 ends on 1992-03-30. epb.ext88.json ends 조순 on 1990-03-17, so the lineages differ on this reshuffle.
